source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    Enter BMC Web UI -> Select "Hardware status" > Click tab "Inventory and LEDs" then check the Chassis information and detail information
And Compare FRU data with ipmitool fru print to check if contect correct or not

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.

original_test_intent: Verify the intended system-control module's FRU is readable and correct across WebUI and IPMI, with Redfish used only after exact SCM member resolution.
original_method: Bind the physical/control-plane SCM to its management objects, collect complete read-only FRU evidence, and compare normalized fields including PartNumber against the approved assembly record without invoking SCM control.
manual_activity: The owner identifies the exact SCM, approves PartNumber/field semantics and the assembly baseline; the agent may perform protected reads and comparisons only, while the engineer decides acceptance.
required_inputs: Complete FRU field and encoding rules
safety_requirements: Do not invoke SCM control, reset, firmware or FRU-write actions.
Resolve the SCM from actual inventory and platform mapping; do not trust a guessed URI.
Use trusted transport and protected credentials.
Do not accept PartNumber alone as complete FRU parity.
Stop on ambiguous or duplicate SCM identity without retry-by-guess.
agent_execution_scope: Resolve the approved SCM instance and its Redfish/IPMI objects.
Collect complete redacted read-only records and WebUI detail.
Normalize PartNumber and all required fields with presence/encoding rules.
Compare with the approved assembly record and report discrepancies.
Return evidence only; make no control-plane change.
engineer_actions: Approve the SCM identity and object mapping.
Approve field semantics, reference and redaction.
Review any cross-source mismatch and set formal verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Only a partial assumed read: it lacks SCM identity proof, complete IPMI/UI reconciliation and trusted TLS.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Discover and bind the exact SCM member, use protected reads for complete Redfish/IPMI data, and compare against WebUI/reference without SCM actions.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: FRU_SCM, WebUI/ipmitool comparison, Criterion and original time values remain preserved.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Perform complete identity-bound SCM FRU parity under a no-control boundary.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record BMC, Redfish schema and IPMI decoder versions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Vendor SCM topology/FRU definition and Project assembly record.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds exact SCM/control-plane binding, complete protected evidence and explicit prohibition of availability-affecting actions while retaining source interfaces.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: A guessed endpoint and three selected properties are only partial evidence; correct FRU data does not validate SCM control functions.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: SCM map, field rules and approved assembly reference.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: A plausible value from the wrong control module can conceal mapping error; SCM control/reset can affect manageability.

project_override_considerations: An alternate collector needs engineer approval, exact SCM binding, field-equivalence evidence and explicit accounting for uncovered WebUI/IPMI coverage.
expected_evidence: WebUI capture and approved assembly reference

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Master consistently requests SCM FRU readability and correctness; absent mapping and expected values are execution-readiness inputs.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The inventory purpose is clear and can await Project SCM mapping/reference without becoming permanently blocked.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Adds actual SCM discovery, trusted transport and complete cross-source parity.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Independently agrees with hybrid classification and management-plane safety boundary.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.round_02: Replaces generic direct-run treatment with explicit control-module mapping and no-control limits.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.related_source_cases: Prevents PDB/SYS records from satisfying SCM coverage.

review_improvement: Makes management-critical module identity and PartNumber semantics testable while preventing a partial API sample from being promoted to full FRU coverage.
independent_technical_reasoning: SCM naming is platform-specific and may denote a service/control board whose reset or control affects the management plane. Static FRU comparison is safe only after exact object binding; PartNumber is assembly evidence, not by itself proof that every required FRU field or control function is correct.
